title: Water Can Boil and Freeze at the Same Time
description: At one special temperature and pressure, water can be solid, liquid and gas all at once.

scenes.text: Water can boil and freeze at the exact same time.
scenes.subject: ice
scenes.say: [curious] Water can boil and freeze... at the EXACT same time.

scenes.text: It happens at something called the triple point, where ice, liquid water and water vapor can all exist together.
scenes.say: It happens at something called the triple point, where ice, liquid water and water vapor can all exist together.

scenes.text: It needs a temperature just above zero degrees Celsius, and a pressure far lower than the air around us.
scenes.subject: water
scenes.say: It needs a temperature just above zero degrees Celsius, and a pressure far lower than the air around us.

scenes.text: In a lab with a vacuum pump, you can watch water bubble like it is boiling while ice forms on top.

scenes.say: [excited] In a lab with a vacuum pump, you can watch water bubble like it is boiling while ice forms on top.
